**Finding: MINCOMMIT — compliant (preferred position met).**

The Agreement contains no take-or-pay exposure for Sparkling:

- **§ 11 (p0084):** payment obligation is limited to "the fees as set out in the Fee Schedule" — no committed spend or minimum quantity.
- **§ 2 (p0028):** additional fees arise only if Sparkling voluntarily extends use beyond the Authorized Locations — usage-based, not a commitment.
- **§ 10 (p0065):** maintenance is a "renewable one-year term," so there is no multi-year committed maintenance tail.
- **§ 17(a)–(b) (p0117–p0118):** the licence continues only while fees are paid, and Sparkling may terminate at any time on 90 days' notice — an unconditional exit even if a commitment were later asserted.
- **§ 3:** restrictions are copying/sublicensing limits, not volume caps on Sparkling's usage.

No redline proposed. The only residual watch-item is Schedule "A" (Fee Schedule), which is not reproduced in the reviewed text — if it contains minimum licence counts or committed maintenance years, we would re-open the point and narrow to the fallback (current 12-month term, reducible on 30 days' notice, true-up not penalty).
